fact: The Ministry of Education and Human Resource's Annual Report 2025-2026 says collaboration was explored with UNESCO and Community Systems Foundation towards establishing a national EMIS, with assistance sought from UNDP, and that implementation of the national EMIS depends on renewed implementation frameworks, regulatory approvals and sustainable funding; its Education Statistics Unit lists a full-fledged centralised EMIS as a challenge still to be developed, and no primary school is stated as using one.
title: Annual Report 2025-2026 - Minister Submission Copy
publisher: Ministry of Education and Human Resource, Mauritius
